IHC No-     192/24
Gross :-  Received paraffin tissue block No.MDRC- 10075/24
IHC performed on block no 10075/24


Clinical Details : Cytopenias with suspcion of plasma cell dyscrasia.

IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY RESULTS

CD138 IHC – CD138 immunostaining shows few singly scattered cells. Distribution of positive cells is highly variable throughout the section examined. No clusters or aggregates noted. Overall percentage (of plasma cells) ~1-2%.

 
IMPRESSION: Immunohistomorphology findings show no definite increase in plasma cells.
Comments : Advised correlation with other investigations and clinical details.


 Notes :
 1. This test was performed on paraffin embedded tissue section.
2. Detection system used – Biogenex  Real Envision Detection system, peroxidase/ DAB + Rabbit/mouse.
3. The impression is based on the material submitted and is not a complete surgical pathlogy report.
4. Improper Fixation may affect results. 
5. This assay has not been validated on decalified tissue. Results should be interpreted with caution given the likelihood or false negativity of decalcified specimen.
 Fixative requirement :
 1. The volume of formalin fixative should be atleast 10 times the volume of the specimen
2. Specimens should be immersed in 10% neutral buffered formalin within 1 hours of the biopsy/ resection procedure ( time of removal and time of immersion to be mentioned )
3. In all resection (large) specimens , the tumour must be bisected prior to immersion in fixative.
